On the island of the monks of the White Raven Monastery, a brother disappeared in the Ghostlands. First you find the fisherman {npc:Dalbrect}'s {item:Family Brooch} in the Ghostlands, and from then on he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings}. Then the abbot {npc:Costello} asks you to investigate the disappearance of brother Fugio: you recover the {item:Monk's Diary} and receive a {item:Blessed Ankh}.
There is an island inhabited by an order of monks; one of those monks has disappeared in the Ghostlands.
Hole beneath the wall to the Ghostlands (west of Carlin)
Spell or speed potions ({spell:Haste}) so you can run through the magic walls again
Area attack runes (for example {item:Great Fireball Rune|GFB}) for the undead
Access to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} (Dalbrect takes you for 10 gp)
{npc:Dalbrect}'s boat to the Isle of the Kings
Mission 1: when you hand the {item:Family Brooch} to Dalbrect ({key:brooch}).
10 gp per trip ({key:passage}). If you enter the restricted area on the 3rd floor of the monastery and do not pay the fine to {npc:Costello}, Dalbrect stops taking you.
Protected doors of the Isle of the Kings catacombs
Mission 2 (*The Investigation*): when you talk to {npc:Costello} about {key:Fugio}.
Requires mission 1 to be completed (access to the Isle of the Kings, for the {item:Spectral Cloth}).
Requires this quest to be completed (access to the Isle of the Kings).
You need mission 1 (to reach the Isle of the Kings): it is a requirement on the AVIN branch; on the CGB branch you can do it before or during mission 6.
The investigation part includes magic walls that only go down temporarily with levers; it is easier with a team and with {spell:Haste}.
{creature:Stalker|Stalkers} turn invisible: bring something to attack around you (area runes).
1. A Family Brooch (access to the Isle of the Kings)

Go to **Carlin** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}). West of the city, enter the {wiki:Ghostlands} by passing under the wall through this hole.
Going down in the abandoned house
In the Ghostlands, go to the abandoned house to the **south** and go down inside it.
In the house's basement you may find a {creature:Demon Skeleton} and one or two {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}.
In the basement, follow the corridor **south** and go down the stairs.
Route in the abandoned house basement
On this level, go **east** to the end of the passage and then loop round to the **south** room. Go up the stairs in that room.

At the entrance there may be 1–2 {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}. If you go north you risk meeting more Stalkers, several {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and a {creature:Wild Warrior} disguised as a Knight Statue. In the final room there are about 2 Demon Skeletons, 2 Stalkers and 2–4 Ghouls.
Use the **head of the top coffin** to find the {item:Family Brooch}.
Use the head of the top coffin

Go back the same way: go down the stairs of the south room, return along the passage to the **west**, go up the corridor stairs to the basement and leave the abandoned house. Then head **north** to the hole under the wall and return to Carlin.

Take the brooch to {npc:Dalbrect} and say {key:hi}, {key:brooch}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He now considers you a friend and takes you to the Isle of the Kings. He is in the hut next to his boat, in the harbour **north and west** of Carlin (north of the Ghostlands).
Access to the Isle of the Kings
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)
Travelling to the Isle of the Kings
Whenever you want, say {key:passage} and {key:yes} to {npc:Dalbrect}: he takes you to the Isle of the Kings for 10 gp.
On the Isle of the Kings, talk to the abbot {npc:Costello} (in the building on the east side). Say {key:hi}, {key:Fugio} and {key:yes}. You can now open the protected doors of the catacombs.
In the caves beneath the monastery there is a hole (pick hole) that leads to the Banshee Quest area, but the diary is in the Ghostlands.
Leave the Isle of the Kings
To return to the mainland, go to the boat moored on the island and talk to {npc:Captain Jack}, Dalbrect's friend: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. He takes you back to the mainland, to the Carlin side.
Do not enter the 3rd floor of the monastery (the monks' restricted area): if you do, Captain Jack will not take you back until you pay the fine to {npc:Costello} ({key:absolution}).
Going to the cave in the Ghostlands
Go back to the Ghostlands (through the hole under the wall, west of Carlin) and head to this cave.

Go down into the cave marked **A** (it has several {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}). Go to the end of the cave: in a structure you find undead — {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and a {creature:Bonelord}. Defeat some of them with a {item:Great Fireball Rune|GFB} or another strong attack, **pull the lever** and run back (with haste) to where the two magic walls were.
The lever at the end of cave A

Go down **three levels** to the big cave. The passage furthest to the **right**, marked **B**, leads to a {creature:Giant Spider} guarding a lever that lowers one of the magic walls. Kill the Giant Spider, **pull the lever** and go back with {spell:Haste} to the magic walls.
Passage B with the Giant Spider and the lever

Pass **with the whole team at the same time** through the spot of the magic walls, marked **C**. Keep the group together: before the hole there is a spot that resets the walls. Go down the hole and follow the passage **north**.
The magic walls (C) and the route to the body
In this passage there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and a {creature:Mummy}.
Further on you find a {item:Dead Human (Quest)}. Use the body to receive a {item:Backpack} with a book ({item:They Are Coming (Book)}) and other things. That book is the {item:Monk's Diary}.

Go back along the passage and use the portal to leave the cave. Then climb up through the holes you came down (use the {item:Rope}) to the surface of the Ghostlands and return to Carlin through the hole under the wall.

Take the book to the Isle of the Kings ({npc:Dalbrect} takes you: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}) and talk to {npc:Costello}: {key:hi}, {key:diary}, {key:yes}. He examines it and gives you a {item:Blessed Ankh}.
For the quest to show as completed in the Quest Log, talk to {npc:Costello} again and say {key:diary}. He thanks you and the quest is complete.
To leave the island, talk to {npc:Captain Jack} on the moored boat again: {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. He takes you to the Carlin side.
